added_failures_note: measured: baseline_suite at b48deaa93 names 1 failure (test_book_primal_keeps_exact_diverted_moments, logs/base-arm.log:41) and after_suite at 936c1b95c names 0 (logs/head-arm.log:6, 5 passed); the after arm's failure set is empty so no failure is added.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The reference npz's key set diverges from the booked namedtuple's fields, e.g. a field renamed or added on either side.
The booking's validity flag flips from True, or its dtype becomes non-boolean so the exact comparison branch is never taken.

Any booked numeric entry moves more than 1e-12 relative to the stored reference, or more than the 1e-15 absolute floor for an entry near zero; the 1e-9 reference perturbation at logs/negative-control-perturb-1e-9.log:1-2 demonstrates the comparison fires.

findings.text: non-blocking: the docstring states the reference arrays were written at revision b48deaa93f by a command that imports _booked_diverted, but that helper does not exist at b48deaa93 (git show b48deaa93:tests/test_bank_step_booking.py has no such symbol), so the stated provenance cannot be re-run at the stated revision.
non-blocking: the paired-arms paragraph records the head arm as 5 passed in 146.4 s while logs/head-arm.log:6 records 5 passed in 156.06 s, so the fragment disagrees with the log it cites.

non-blocking: the bit-only reorder control the done-when requires was not produced (logs/negative-control-sum-reorder.log:12 FIELDS-WITH-CHANGED-BITS 0 over four attempts), so the tolerance is never exercised against a bit-changing reorder; the acceptance criterion is disclosed as unmet rather than substituted.

item_verdicts.diff: One commit (936c1b95c) against b48deaa93f55ad2c759c5977ed611b9047e393fb changes three files, +110/-23: the test rewrite, the new reference npz, and a 50-line evidence fragment. No production code is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: Clause 1 is met (each field asserted against the stored reference, 5 passed at head). Clause 2 is half met: logs/negative-control-perturb-1e-9.log:1-2 shows the 1e-9 perturbation failing as required (1 failed, EXIT=1), but logs/negative-control-sum-reorder.log:9-13 records FIELDS-WITH-CHANGED-BITS 0, so the required bit-changing reorder was never produced. Clause 3's transition is recorded (base 1 failed/4 passed at logs/base-arm.log:42, head 5 passed at logs/head-arm.log:6) but the arms ran in place on the held allocation, not in the all_debug job the clause names.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal (brief.txt:1-3) is to replace the SHA-256 digest pin on the booked arrays with a tolerance comparison against stored reference arrays; tests/test_bank_step_booking.py:40-82 at 936c1b95c does exactly that, loading tests/data/booking_primal_diverted.npz and asserting each field.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; reckon crew check --manifest returns ok:true with no findings. It cites four logs, both arms as complete, and outside_scope honestly records the unmet bit-only control. Two in-repo citations drift from the logs: head wall clock 146.4 s in the fragment versus 156.06 s at logs/head-arm.log:6, and the capture command in the docstring imports a helper absent at the revision it cites.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest's orientation_write_paths names four paths; the diff b48deaa93..936c1b95c touches three of them (tests/test_bank_step_booking.py, tests/data/booking_primal_diverted.npz, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/booking-pin-tolerance.html) and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_bank_step_booking.py:76-82 compares the code's output against arrays loaded from an independent file, so it fails if booking values move beyond 1e-12 relative; a 1e-9 perturbation of the reference reddens it (logs/negative-control-perturb-1e-9.log:1-2), but the bit-only reorder it is meant to tolerate could not be produced, so that half of the guard is unexercised.
justifications.evidence: The gate's head arm is recorded (5 passed, logs/head-arm.log:6) but done-when clause 2 is unmet: logs/negative-control-sum-reorder.log:12 prints FIELDS-WITH-CHANGED-BITS 0, and the paired arms were run in place rather than in the all_debug job the clause names.
justifications.fit: tests/test_bank_step_booking.py:18-28 follows the surrounding idiom (Path(__file__).with_name matching tests/test_layer_fetch.py:14, np.testing.assert_allclose as at tests/test_current_diffusion.py:319) and introduces no name the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_bank_step_booking.py:76-82 replaces the digest pin with np.testing.assert_allclose(rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) against tests/data/booking_primal_diverted.npz, which is the deliverable the goal states.
justifications.reuse: The diff adds only the local helper _booked_diverted at tests/test_bank_step_booking.py:31 and delegates comparison to np.testing.assert_allclose; a search over tests/ and nova/ for a shared stored-reference or assert_close helper found only a mask-specific local helper at tests/test_clipped_support_quadrature.py:101, so no owned capability is duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the b48deaa93..936c1b95c diff lies inside the four declared write paths, and the diff carries no production change the goal does not imply.
